head: SERIF
dzh: 旧纸底、贴纸片、胶带条，像日记本
den: Old paper, pasted scraps and tape, like a journal
nzh: 底色是旧纸，块像贴上去的纸片，稍微歪一两度；用胶带条、标签、剪下来的色块当装饰；标题用衬线粗字，旁边可加小号批注；元素可以互相压一点边，别排得太整齐
nen: Old-paper background, blocks like pasted scraps tilted a degree or two; decorate with tape strips, labels and cut-out color shapes; bold serif headings with small side notes; let pieces overlap a little, never perfectly aligned
